ask: Issue #5: jelly ask says so when its --at matches nothing

groups.evidence:
Seven asks in a row against one daemon, in ms:
3745  730  725  720  725  775  724

Before this change: 4 ms.

The first version waited for the browser to exit and took 8 s most times: headless Chrome posts its snapshot and then lingers. Now the check answers when the snapshot is in.

show.after:
$ jelly ask plan "Which order?" --option a="Newest first" --option b="Oldest first" --at "#nope"
#nope matches nothing on the page, so it shows at the top
show.before:
$ jelly ask plan "Which order?" --option a="Newest first" --option b="Oldest first" --at "#nope"
it shows on the page below #nope
show.caption: The page has no #nope. Before, the reply named a place the card never went.
Where the person sees the card. The page did this already; now the reply tells the agent which one happened.

groups.why: Every ask with --at now renders the page once: about 0.7 s instead of 4 ms.

groups.evidence:
$ jelly ask plan "Which order?" --option a="Newest first" --option b="Oldest first" --at "#list"
demo:plan v2: asked a1 "Which order?"; it shows on the page below #list. Answers arrive in `jelly inbox`
$ jelly ask plan "Which order?" --option a="Newest first" --option b="Oldest first" --at "#nope"
demo:plan v2: asked a1 "Which order?"; #nope matches nothing on the page, so it shows at the top. Answers arrive in `jelly inbox`
$ jelly look plan "Check the title" --at "#nope"
demo:plan v3: asked a2 "Check the title"; #nope matches nothing on the page, so it shows at the top. Answers arrive in `jelly inbox`
groups.intent: Say where the card really shows

it shows below #nope if that matches something, else at the top: not checked (…)

groups.why: Wording only. The event that listeners and the log get is unchanged.

$ cargo test
test tests::an_ask_says_where_its_card_really_shows ... ok

test result: ok. 19 passed; 0 failed
